verdict.rationale: Base44's entire product is built around natural-language-to-app generation, with docs describing managed backend, data entities, SDK/CLI, and hands-on HN reports confirming users described apps in prompts and got working full-stack apps (with DB, auth, etc.) deployed quickly. Missing for 10: independent technical benchmarking of output quality/scalability and more than anecdotal corroboration beyond a single HN thread.
